recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is and do not make further FHIR-19521 source changes. Treat FHIR-31523 as duplicate/background unless a future run specifically audits duplicate trackers or v2-to-FHIR mapping implications.
issue_request: FHIR-19521 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 by PA. It requested changing Appointment.comment cardinality to 0..* and changing the datatype to Annotation, with the final resolution naming the element Appointment.note 0..* Annotation.
initial_application: Commit 3a346f049dfa3b384b08390de836036a0afcc384 applied #19521 by changing source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml from Appointment.comment 0..1 string to Appointment.note 0..* Annotation and migrating Appointment examples from comment to note/text.
additional_context: Appointment is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml defines Appointment.note as 0..* Annotation, and current Appointment examples no longer use the old Appointment.comment element. FHIR-31523 later requested multiple Appointment comments and was closed as a duplicate/background tracker citing FHIR-19521; PA and OO minutes support the same interpretation. FHIR-27849 and FHIR-39557 are adjacent scheduling-resource changes but do not alter the seed decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The required local outcome is already present in the authoritative current Appointment source, so an empty no-change audit commit was published to the combined branch.
